about_the_game:
A pack of small additional features for those who want to support the game. 

  • Model Viewer - View and even rotate (wow!) an unlockable selection of models from the game. 

  • Music Player - Unlock and listen to music from the game without running all over town. 

  • Photo Mode - free camera around (within a limited range) at almost any time and adjust color palette and other color and view options and take screenshots

content_descriptors.notes: Contains Mature language, mild sexual imagery, and non-violent mild gore.
